prompt: Why does the vane need a BIG tail and a small point?

options.text: The wind pushes hardest on the biggest surface, so the tail is shoved downwind until the arrow points into the wind
So birds can sit on it

explanation: Maximum push on the tail, minimum on the point — the arrow rests only when it points straight into the wind.
